related_gaps.rationale: This changes which paths force a standard task or a receipt; the page gate's commit-order and page checks are untouched.
The protected-path list is local policy; hosting rules stay the owner's to configure.

gap_review: Read the four open gaps. artifact-gate-holes and hosting-enforcement are near this work and unaffected; product-acceptance and platform-qualification are unrelated.

discoveries.summary: Skill frontmatter can register hooks, grant tools and run shell commands, so a skill can leave the receipt only while cargo xtask docs holds it to plain text (DOC011 to DOC013); the same carve-out was dropped in workflow-router for want of that check.
Agent host folders below the repository root, such as crates/app/.claude/skills/, escaped both the receipt and the tier rule; DOC014 now refuses them.

The edit guard gives no note for a bare top-level protected folder (rm -r .claude, rm -r xtask), and any one-segment path under .claude/skills/ gets a note even when handoff needs no receipt; completion and CI still judge the files.

discovery_review: Three discoveries, each recorded where its next reader looks: the frontmatter and nested-folder rules in docs/ARTIFACTS.md Task size, and the guard's coarseness in the implementation notes. One scratch-only observation from a page author (the guard reads a redirect target against the event's cwd after a cd) is carried in the buy-in doc.

documentation.rationale: ARTIFACTS.md Task size names the three ceremony skills and the docs checks that hold every other skill to text; COMPLETION.md says a skill folder outside the ceremony needs no receipt; the write-ticket skill tells ticket writers that other skills can change in a small task.

summary: Narrow the protected and ceremony paths so skills outside the task-page ceremony can change in a small task, while the ceremony skills, agents and host config stay standard.

review.acceptance: All four named tests exist and pass: unrelated_skills_stay_small (investigate in both hosts, its seed and a new skill stay small with no receipt; a ceremony skill needs both), protected_cargo_and_ceremony_paths_force_standard extended to each ceremony skill in both hosts, mixed case, a loose skills-folder file, the docs/skills pointers, .claude/settings.json, a new non-skill .claude/ file and the agents, guard_passes_unrelated_skills_without_a_receipt_note (including a bare ceremony folder), and guard_tiers_match_protected_paths extended to CEREMONY_SKILLS. Added beyond the ticket, as the plan records: free_skills_stay_plain_text (DOC011 to DOC014) and transitions::tests::only_ceremony_skills_stay_protected_under_claude.
review.verification: cargo xtask check ci passed 9 of 9 in a clean clone at the final commit (target/verification/ci.json); cargo xtask gaps --base origin/main is ok with the one policy receipt covering ten protected files. Pages: blindspots.html pass in round 3 (0 findings); interventions.html pass in round 1 (0); interview.html pass in round 1 (0); reference.html pass in round 3 (0); plan.html pass in round 2 (0); implementation.html pass in round 1 (0); buy-in.html pass in round 2 (0); quiz.html best of three rounds, the round-2 version, with 2 open findings: its pass message miscounts the record's remaining steps, and one captured guard line is wrapped for display. unrelated_skills_stay_small and guard_passes_unrelated_skills_without_a_receipt_note were run against the old rules and failed there.
review.assumptions: Hosts load only the frontmatter and !-syntax that DOC011 and DOC012 look for; a host that grows a new way to run code from a skill's Markdown would need the checks widened. The check is a line-based allowlist, not a YAML parser, so any unrecognised key or spelling is refused. Skill names are assumed case-insensitive on some checkouts, so the ceremony match ignores case. The owner answered no discovery page; nine agent's calls are carried open in buy-in.html.
review.coverage: A hook added to a skill outside the ceremony is refused at cargo xtask docs and CI, not at the edit; the guard stays advisory and is coarser than handoff in both directions (recorded as a discovery). The 100-line limit still counts every host copy. Nothing tests how Claude Code or Codex actually load a free skill; the checks pin the files, not host behaviour. Codex was not observed.
